name: Predicting Customer Churn In Marketing
model: Calibrated Logistic Regression / Random Forest Classifier
description: Marketing campaign analytics engine identifying customer churn risks based on email open rates, loyalty points, and campaign decay.
limitations: Privacy changes in email tracking (e.g. proxy caching) introduce noise into open-rate features.
responsible_use_notes: Empowers marketing teams to optimize communication frequency and avoid customer fatigue.
